_about: Table bytes (the object payload, from export offset 0x8a) of the user's REAL AccuMark support files, read from the ZIP 'all support files.zip' (AccuMark Explorer OldFiles, AccuMark 9 data). Only the table bytes are kept - no envelope, no user names; the author / date comment of G-LAYLIMITS is blanked. The Lay Limits Editor showed for scratch copies of these exact bytes: L = Single Ply, Same Size Same Direction, blank options, flip 1, rule 0; G-LAYLIMITS, NEED- TWO WAY, ONE GMT ONW WAY = Single Ply, Alternate Bundle Alternate Direction, DEFAULT = MWS, flip 1, rule 1. Markers that name them: NEED- TWO WAY = 1825D, 5683D; G-LAYLIMITS = 418T; ALL GMT WAY (2591A) is still missing.

block_buffers._about: the four side values (u16, x 10000 inches) of the real 3MM / 3MM-N objects; equal sides, so they cannot show the side order
